resources.string: This app asks Keyra to type a login after you press Keyra\'s button. It never sees or keeps your passwords.
In Keyra\'s web app open Settings → Apps and agents, create a token of the kind \"App\" and paste it here. To scan its QR code, use your camera app, copy the text and paste it.
A token is saved. Leave the field empty to keep it.

plurals.name: connection_ok
plurals.item: Connected. This token can use %1$d login.
Connected. This token can use %1$d logins.

resources.string: Enter an address such as http://keyra.local or http://192.168.4.1. Plain HTTP is allowed only for addresses on your local network.
A token starts with keyra_ followed by 32 letters and digits.
The saved token can no longer be read on this phone. Paste the token again.
None yet. When you pick a login for an app or site, you can remember the choice.
This app keeps only Keyra\'s address, the access token (encrypted with a key in the Android Keystore) and the apps and sites you chose. No passwords, usernames or codes are ever stored on the phone.
No logins are available to this token.
Put the cursor in the field on the device Keyra types into, then press the button.
Keyra saves this login when you press its button.
Cancelled. Nothing was typed or saved.
Time ran out. Nothing was typed or saved.
Lost contact with Keyra. Check Keyra itself for the result.
Can\'t reach Keyra. Check that the phone is on Keyra\'s Wi-Fi or the same home network, and the address in Settings.
Keyra is locked. Unlock it in its web app, then try again.
Keyra does not accept this token. It may have been revoked: create a new one in Keyra\'s web app.
Keyra is waiting for another request. Long-press its button to cancel that request.

plurals.name: err_rate_limited
plurals.item: Too many requests. Try again in %1$d second.
Too many requests. Try again in %1$d seconds.

resources.string: This login is not available to this token.
This token cannot do that. Create a token of the kind \"App\".
Keyra\'s clock is not set, so it cannot make a 2FA code yet.
No request of yours is waiting for the button.
This account changed after you asked. Nothing was typed; request it again.
Keyra is not connected to the computer by USB. Connect it and try again.
No paired Bluetooth device connected in time. Check that it is nearby and Bluetooth is on, then try again.
Keyra was disconnected or the computer went to sleep before the press. Nothing was typed; try again.
This login contains a character Keyra cannot type with the selected keyboard layout. Change the layout or edit the login.
Keyra could not finish. Check the device and try again.
This record was saved by a newer Keyra version. Update Keyra to read it.
Keyra cannot read this record because it is damaged. Check Keyra’s web app; do not overwrite it.
Keyra rejected this request. Check its fields and try again.
This login does not match the current site. Choose it explicitly in Keyra.
This request is too large for Keyra.
This action is not supported by Keyra. Check its firmware version.
Keyra has no room for another account.
Keyra rejected this request for security reasons. Reconnect and try again.
%1$s. Tap to remove this remembered choice.
Set up the connection to Keyra first.
Made by Keyra\'s hardware random generator and not stored anywhere. To keep it, save the login to Keyra.
Copied. The clipboard is cleared in 60 seconds.
Keyra is ready (%1$s): tap the field if needed, then press Keyra\'s button.
Keyra adds this login after you press its button. Nothing is kept on the phone.
A newer request replaced this one. Nothing was typed.
USB when a computer is plugged in, otherwise the last Bluetooth device
Update Keyra to 0.4.2 or later to choose a Bluetooth device here.
Bluetooth is turned off on Keyra. Turn it on in Keyra\'s web app to type into a phone.
Could not ask Keyra for its devices.
Keyra types into this phone as a Bluetooth keyboard. First press Keyra\'s button to let a new device pair, then choose Keyra in this phone\'s Bluetooth settings.
Keyra opens pairing for 2 minutes after the press.
In Bluetooth settings, tap \"Keyra\" and confirm. This screen notices the new pairing by itself.
This phone is paired. Keyra now types into it.
No new device paired in time. Try again.
Put the cursor in the field on the device Keyra types into, then press the button.
Put the cursor in the field on the computer, then press Keyra\'s button.
Open the app or site, tap the field, then press Keyra\'s button. Keyra types here as a keyboard.
Put the cursor in the field on %1$s, then press Keyra\'s button.
Not chosen yet. Autofill types into this phone only after you choose it under \"Where should Keyra type?\".
Keyra types into this phone as \"%1$s\".
Choose this phone in Keyra\'s app first (Accounts → Types into → This is my phone), so Keyra types here and not into a computer.
